description: `identity.subject` is in trust domain `staging.example.com`, for which the verifier has no bundle. The JWT-SVID is otherwise valid for that subject and is signed by the `prod.example.com` authority key, with that key's `kid`, so its signature would verify under the prod bundle. RFC-AITP-0002 §6.2 and §6.5 step 3: the verifier uses only the bundle of the subject's trust domain, and there is none. The verifier is agentA (`self_aid`, kat-keypair-001), configured to accept `spiffe`, with the `spiffe_bundles` store in `input.trust_anchors_config`: one bundle, for `prod.example.com`, holding the run-time test JWT-SVID authority and X.509 CA (PLACEHOLDERS.md). The sender is agentB (kat-keypair-002). Draft fixture for the Proposed `spiffe` identity type (RFC-AITP-0002 §6): a default runner SKIPs it.

expected.rationale: No `spiffe_bundles` entry names `staging.example.com`, so verification fails at §6.5 step 3, before any signature check. A key from the `prod.example.com` bundle MUST NOT validate an SVID for another trust domain.
